name: Gilteritinib (FLT3 inhibitor, R/R)

institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard guidelines (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

monitoring: CBC and marrow response; bridge responders to allogeneic transplant.

drugs.name: Gilteritinib
drugs.notes: 120 mg PO once daily, continuously, for relapsed/refractory FLT3-mutated AML; may titrate to 200 mg/day for inadequate response. Bridge responders to allogeneic transplant; consider post-transplant FLT3-inhibitor maintenance. Standard Guidelines (NCCN) / DeVita, general reference.
